`_raise_unhealthy_startup` (store.py) treats ANY `PRAGMA foreign_key_check` row as a global StartupIntegrityError -> fail-closed MAINTENANCE; there is no narrower branch that distinguishes a missing-WorkflowBlob-parent violation, verifies its frozen digest/media kind, and runs the bounded exclusive-repair path the spec describes. The coarser global fail-closed behavior IS exercised (see the linked test), but the specific bounded repair contract this row requires is not yet implemented in production code -- it is a distinct piece of work, not a test gap.
